setting_note: Frankenstein Village world is broadly 1890s, specific year undecided. Pretorius travels to reconnect with Henry before the film's events. His leased curiosity shop is dark and marked OPENING SOON; the full private laboratory is the back/interior of that building. This is development intent only, not game canon integration.
epoch_requirement: The operator must confirm the specific in-universe year precedes no included physical edition.
layout: Seven physical book IDs in shelf 3 slots 1-7 of a standalone synthetic spatial-v2 fixture, not presumed possessions or experiences of an existing character.
source_policy: Full 21st-century public-domain digital transcriptions are deterministic sources for available textual content. The physical volume's historic typography, page numbers, engravings and historical edition are not established by UTF-8 text extraction. Do not present digital segments as original printed pages.
